description: This file declares functions and data structures for managing network devices' status, harvesting, reporting, and polling periods, as well as configuration reset and logging utilities. It serves as an interface for network device status management within the system.
external_methods: bool isvalueinarray(ULONG val, ULONG *arr, int size)

methods.name: SetNDSHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status for network devices.

methods.name: GetNDSHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves whether harvesting is enabled or disabled.

methods.name: SetNDSReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period for network device scan.

methods.name: GetNDSReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for network devices.

methods.name: SetNDSPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period for network device scan.

methods.name: GetNDSPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for network devices.

methods.name: GetNDSReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default reporting period.

methods.name: SetNDSReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period.

methods.name: GetNDSPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default polling period.

methods.name: SetNDSPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period.

methods.name: GetNDSOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout for accelerated scans.

methods.name: ValidateNDSPeriod
methods.description: Validates that a given period is within the valid range.

methods.name: SetNDSOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the override TTL for network device scans.

methods.name: GetNDSOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the current override TTL value.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeString
methods.description: Returns the current time as a string.

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeInSecond
methods.description: Returns the current time in seconds.

methods.name: isvalueinarray
methods.description: Checks if a value exists within an array of ULONG.

methods.name: ResetNDSReportingConfiguration
methods.description: Resets the network device status reporting configuration.

methods.name: print_list
methods.description: Prints the network device status list.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes the network device status list.
